purpose: Odoo cross-domain data, freshness, pagination, regional/version and risk review.

requiredPermissions: dedicated Odoo bot user with the minimum read access rights, record rules, companies and fields needed for the selected datasets; do not use an Administrator/Settings identity
short-lived bearer API key with controlled rotation/revocation and no steady-state permission to generate or revoke keys
explicit approved customer host plus database identity; provide X-Odoo-Database only where the deployment requires multi-database routing
exact model+method read allowlist derived from the authorised database /doc and reviewed metadata; reject wildcard models/methods
customer-edge HTTPS route for private/on-prem deployments; no direct cloud-to-plant/private-network exposure
dataAvailableOrExpected: employee and organisation reference data where the Employees app and the bot user's read rights expose the relevant model/fields
employee skills/certifications and validity/expiry evidence where Skills/Employees functionality is installed and exposed in the authorised database
planning shifts, roles/resources and working-time context where Planning is installed
attendance check-in/check-out, worked-time, overtime/extra-hours and attendance method/location evidence where Attendances is installed
time-off requests, allocations/balances and approval-state evidence where Time Off is installed
manufacturing orders, work orders, work centres, capacity/cost context, products/SKUs, bills of materials and routing/operation context where Manufacturing is installed
maintenance requests, equipment/work-centre relationships, preventive/corrective maintenance timing and downtime/blocking context where Maintenance is installed
quality checks/results, product/quantity/lot-serial and manufacturing/inventory-order links where Quality is installed
inventory/WIP, products, stock movements, purchasing/supplier context, valuation and production-cost evidence where Inventory/Purchase/Accounting are installed
finance, analytic/cost-centre and manufacturing-cost evidence where Accounting/localisation modules expose it to the integration identity
stableIdentifiers: preserve Odoo record id only as a source key namespaced by connection, host, database and model; never treat an integer id as globally unique across databases/models
preserve company id and source company scope for multi-company records, while business numbers/names remain matching aids rather than cross-company global ids
preserve model name, database, Odoo version and schema fingerprint so custom modules or upgrades cannot silently reinterpret historical records

freshnessLatency.json2: WFM-controlled bounded polling; every call has its own SQL transaction, so preserve first-start/last-finish observation windows for multi-call datasets
freshnessLatency.singleCall: prefer search_read or a provider/customer method that returns a logically coupled read in one transaction when consistency matters
freshnessLatency.legacyRpc: migration-only; freshness depends on polling and the customer deployment
freshnessLatency.events: no generic provider event/webhook completeness contract is claimed by this evidence delta; polling and reconciliation remain authoritative

paginationDeltaEvents.pagination: use reviewed ORM read methods with explicit fields and bounded offset/limit windows; checkpoint only after a complete bounded page sequence
paginationDeltaEvents.delta: use reviewed model timestamps such as write_date only when the authorised database schema and model semantics prove them suitable, with overlap replay and stable-ID dedupe
paginationDeltaEvents.events: none claimed generically; a customer-specific automated-action/webhook/custom module requires separate evidence and security review
paginationDeltaEvents.reconciliation: never infer deletion from an incremental/domain-filtered or permission-limited read; reconcile complete scans only after database/company/model scope and every page are proven complete

rateLimitsAndRetries: Odoo public JSON-2 documentation reviewed here does not establish one universal request-rate contract across Online, Odoo.sh and on-prem deployments; discover/measure the customer deployment and keep concurrency bounded
401/403 stop blind retry and enter credential/record-rule/field-permission diagnostics; they never expand model/method authority or trigger fallback to broader credentials
429/retryable 5xx use bounded exponential backoff with jitter for idempotent reads and preserve the source checkpoint; do not downgrade to legacy RPC because of throttling/outage
partial pages, timeouts or high cross-call skew trigger overlap replay/reconciliation before downstream data is treated as current
versionsRegionsCustomFields: JSON-2 is new in Odoo 19; as of 20 September 2026 Odoo's support table lists Odoo SaaS 19.4 (July 2026) and Odoo 19.0 for Online/Odoo.sh/on-prem, so route selection must be deployment/version-aware rather than assuming all tenants are identical
legacy XML-RPC/JSON-RPC common/object services are deprecated in Odoo 19 and retained only for customer versions that require migration compatibility
actual models, fields and methods vary by installed apps, custom modules and database configuration; use /doc plus schema fingerprinting rather than a global hard-coded field map
Odoo supports Online, Odoo.sh and on-premise deployments; hosted databases can have region choices and customer-specific domains while on-prem data location is customer-controlled
preserve original currencies, units, languages/Unicode, local dates/calendars, company timezone and source timezone; canonical conversion requires explicit semantic-layer provenance
dataGaps: no authorised Odoo 19 Custom-plan test database was available to prove bearer authentication, database routing, exact bot-user access rights/record rules/fields, denied writes or real read round-trips

provider documentation intentionally makes models, fields and methods database-specific; exact canonical mappings cannot be certified until /doc and metadata from an authorised customer/test database are observed
no universal JSON-2 rate-limit contract was established from the reviewed public provider documentation, so customer/deployment limits require measurement or explicit provider evidence
no generic event/webhook completeness contract is claimed; customer automated actions/custom modules must be evaluated separately
local payroll/localisation modules, custom fields and third-party apps can materially change available HR/finance semantics and remain tenant-specific

external API access is documented for Custom pricing plans, so Standard/One App Free customers need an alternative authorised export/file/iPaaS route or plan capability rather than an assumed API connection
constraintsRisks: the same HTTP POST transport invokes both reads and writes, so method-level authority is a mandatory safety boundary
record rules and multi-company visibility can cause apparently complete reads to omit records; absence cannot become deletion evidence until scope and completeness are proven
separate JSON-2 calls are separate SQL transactions, creating race/skew risk for cross-model joins unless observation windows and reconciliation are retained
custom modules and Online intermediate releases can cause schema drift between otherwise similar Odoo customers, so hard-coded global field assumptions are unsafe
three-month maximum API-key lifetime creates a predictable rotation/revocation operational dependency that must self-diagnose before expiry
legacy RPC deprecation creates a migration deadline; version fallback must be intentional and never triggered by credentials, rate limits or outages
